content:
Total without first-digit restriction:  
\[
\binom{7}{4}\cdot P(6,3)=35\cdot 120=4200
\]
Bad cases where the first digit is \(2\): choose positions for \(0,1,8\) among the remaining 6 positions, then fill the other 3 positions:
\[
\binom{6}{3}\cdot P(6,3)=20\cdot 120=2400
\]
Thus:
\[
4200-2400=1800
\]

\boxed{1800}
